name: homedata
description: Look up UK homes and neighbourhoods in ChatGPT with your Homedata account: EPC rating, council tax band, flood risk, schools, broadband, crime, planning and house price trends.

interface.longDescription:
Homedata answers questions about UK homes and the neighbourhoods around them. Give it an address or a postcode and ask about a house, flat or area in your own words: how energy efficient a home is and its EPC rating, which council tax band it is in, whether it is at risk of flooding, radon or other environmental hazards, what planning applications have been made nearby, which schools are close and how Ofsted rated them, how fast the broadband is and whether full fibre is available, how much crime is recorded in the area, how deprived or well-off the neighbourhood is, what shops, parks and other amenities are nearby, and how house prices in the area have moved and grown over the years. For a whole-property question it gives the full picture of one home in a single answer.

It is for anyone researching a home or a neighbourhood: people buying, renting or moving home, property professionals, and anyone comparing places to live.

Connect your Homedata account to use it. Lookups use your existing account.

Limitations: coverage is the United Kingdom only, and some data (schools, deprivation) covers England only. House price figures are area averages and growth, not the value of any one home. It does not value properties, search homes for sale, or give details about owners or occupants.
capabilities: Look up any UK house, flat or address and its UPRN
Full property overview, EPC energy rating and council tax band
Flood risk, radon and other environmental checks for a home
Planning applications, schools and Ofsted ratings nearby
Broadband and full-fibre speeds, crime and local amenities
House price trends, price growth and deprivation by area
defaultPrompt: What's the flood risk at 10 Downing Street, London SW1A 2AA?
Are there good primary schools near SW1A 2AA?
What's the area around M1 1AE like to live in?

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing and takes no payments. Signed-in users look up data with their existing Homedata account.

publication.release_notes: First release: UK address, property and area lookups for signed-in Homedata users.
